title: Make custom presentation aware of display cadence

definition.title: Make custom presentation aware of display cadence
definition.source_excerpt: Schedule original decoded frames using source timestamps, one master clock and observed display opportunities without interpolation or silent speed changes. Verify actual presentation, not callback counts alone.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Trace the precise owner, generation, reset/flush/commit or allocation being changed. Reproduce the present behavior before removing any guard.
definition.minimum_probe: One short action trace through existing code with the candidate disabled/enabled; include the specific seek, cancellation or replacement transition it can affect.
definition.initial_screen: Trace the precise owner, generation, reset/flush/commit or allocation being changed. Reproduce the present behavior before removing any guard. One short action trace through existing code with the candidate disabled/enabled; include the specific seek, cancellation or replacement transition it can affect.
definition.primary_metric: User-visible operation latency, duplicated work or peak/steady live resource ownership; not object counts alone.
definition.scope_contract: Actual output identity and timeline, surviving consumers, committed generations and cleanup; candidate execution must be visible.
definition.negative_control: Cancel or replace a source at the changed boundary and delay a stale callback/consumer; reject late publication and premature reuse.
definition.stop_boundary: At the first need for a cross-backend ownership redesign, record DEFER_SETUP. Do not remove a semantically required reset or increase a timeout to hide a failure.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Relevant existing runtime/owner only. Do not require every other backend to pass before this independent screen.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

define.basis: Original R169 source contract retained; predeclared fixed-rate custom scheduler profile, one source clock, original frames, independent source pixel identity, cadence gate and exclusions recorded before six comparison trials.

prepare.basis: Generated 72 source-identity VP8 frames; real WebCodecs decode, independent host FFmpeg RGB oracle, native ScreenCaptureKit completed-display timing, exact helper snapshots, wrong-order/speed/cancel controls, owned foreground verification and reproducible commands prepared.

screen.basis: Actual custom timer and display-opportunity presenters ran. Source-to-predicted Chrome feedback was audited and rejected as physical evidence; actual source-labelled WindowServer captured output resolves the previous measurement prerequisite.

correctness.basis: All six normal trials identified all72 original frames in order against independent FFmpeg pixels, <=0.5 mean luma-grid error and >=12.8125 wrong-frame margin. All met <=2% playback-rate slope gate. Wrong-order and20% speed-change controls rejected; cancellation ownership and finalblack output passed.

performance.basis: Three paired trials, first6 frames warmup: median paired p95 completed-display cadence-phase improvement0.1026% versus predeclared15%; no cadence qualification. Secondary p95 issue-to-display latency improvement retained, not substituted for primary gate. No energy, physicaloverlay, audio or productionintegration claim.

results.basis: Completed scoped R169 research with an actual WebCodecs-decoded custom presenter and physical WindowServer output measurements. Three paired timer-versus-rAF trials displayed all 72 original 24fps source frames in order, identified against an independent host FFmpeg pixel oracle; maximum mean grid error was 0.5 luma levels and minimum separation from a wrong frame was 12.8125. ScreenCaptureKit supplied completed-frame displayTime, so the verdict does not rely on rAF/rVFC counts or Chrome's predicted display feedback. Wrong-frame-order and 20% speed-change controls were rejected; cancellation displayed exactly 12 frames and released all issued/source frames, ended the track and cleared the output. Median paired p95 cadence-phase improvement was 0.1026%, below the predeclared 15% gate (individual improvements 0.1026%, 0.02145%, 49.853%). The rAF variant reduced p95 issue-to-display latency to 24.81–24.93ms from 33.74–34.30ms, a recorded secondary finding that does not override the cadence gate. Stop this implementation/profile; this is a negative performance result, not a missing physical-measurement prerequisite. The scope is this isolated video-only 24fps custom presenter on the selected approximately 60Hz display with equal capture overhead. It is not retained/mpv integration, audio/AV-sync, hardware-overlay promotion, photon timing, energy, or general scheduling qualification.
